item.title: Attorney General Ellison secures sweeping measures from Meta to protect children, in largest Big Tech settlement in history
item.description:
Publication Date: August 26, 2026

Child-safety features include hard-cap daily time limits, nighttime blocks, limited school-time access, robust age-assurance measures, and more. Meta to pay Minnesota at least $214M and up to $307M as part of landmark national settlement worth up to $17.1B.

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/08/26_Meta.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues United States Postal Service over unlawful attempt to interfere with states’ vote-by-mail procedures
item.description:
Publication Date: August 26, 2026

Lawsuit seeks to block unconstitutional USPS rule that directs states to overhaul vote-by-mail procedures on an impossible timeline and risks disenfranchising eligible voters

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/08/26_USPS.asp
